Rachel Ryskin is an Assistant Professor of Cognitive & Information Sciences at
UC Merced. She wants to figure out what cognitive processes and computations
enable humans to understand each other. In particular, she studies how learning
and context-specific predictions help the human mind and brain deal with the
noise and ambiguity present in everyday communication.
